name: phone-input

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the country picker open over the field with flags, names and dialling codes.

tagline: Pick a country flag, then type the number; the list searches as you type.
summary: A phone number field with a country flag button on the left. Pressing it opens a searchable list of countries showing flags, names and dialling codes; chosen numbers carry the matching flag.
appearance: A slim bordered field on a dark page, split into a flag button with up-down chevrons and an input reading Enter phone number. The open picker is a rounded panel with a search box above rows of flag, country name and calling code.
behaviour: Clicking the flag opens a scrollable country list that filters as you type in its search box. Choosing a country closes the list and swaps the flag and dialling code; typing the number then fills the field.
demo_content: Countries such as Afghanistan, Albania and United Kingdom with codes +93, +355 and +44.
search_phrases: phone number field with country flag
select country and type phone number
country search while entering a number
use_when: You need international numbers where users pick a country and the right dialling code.
avoid_when: It depends on a country-list package and a popup, so it is heavier than a plain tel field.
customise: Pass value, onChange and defaultCountry plus any native input attributes. The flag set, country list and search come from the phone-number package, styled through classes.
weight_why: Loads the phone-number library, every country flag and a command palette.

a11y.note: The phone field is named only by its placeholder, and the flag button is labelled just by the flag title.

issues: The field is named only by placeholder text, with no visible label.
The flag button shows no country name, so it relies on recognising the flag.
polish_why: Tidy flag-and-search picker; tiny flags and muted codes are the weak spots.
